description: STrengthening the Reporting of OBservational studies in Epidemiology. For observational studies (cohort, case-control, cross-sectional).

questions.question: Is the study design clearly stated (cohort, case-control, cross-sectional)?
Is the setting (location, dates) described?
questions.guidance: Where and when the study was conducted.

questions.question: Is the source population described?
questions.guidance: How participants were identified and recruited.

questions.question: Are all outcome variables clearly defined?
Are measurement methods described in sufficient detail?
Are potential confounders identified and addressed?
Are efforts to address potential sources of bias described?
Is the study size justified?
questions.guidance: Power calculation or sample size rationale.
